description: This file defines the 'Formula' class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, specifically in the LookupRef namespace. It contains a static method 'text' to retrieve the formula text from a specified cell reference, handling errors if the cell or worksheet is invalid.

classes.name: Formula
classes.description: Provides methods for handling formula-related calculations, particularly retrieving formula text from cells.

methods.name: text
methods.description: Retrieves the formula text from a specified cell reference, returning errors if the cell reference is invalid or the cell does not contain a formula.
